data.name: Deben
data.gender_notes: Deben is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deb means 'God' in Sanskrit, and En means 'gift'. So, Deben means 'God's gift'. This name is derived from the Hindu mythology where gods bestow their blessings upon a child with this name. The name Deben carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deben usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deben total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

It also signifies the idea of the deceased ancestors sending their blessings in the form of a 'God's gift' to the child.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name 'Deben' lies in its deep rooted connection with the divine. Also, the name carries an underlying purity and spiritualism, inspiring the individual to live a virtuous life and seek the blessings of the gods in all aspects of life.
